written: 2026-11-10, committed before any gate of the fix round of F2a's PR 2a ran (the commit that adds this file is the timestamp): the fixes to the refuting review's majors M1 (opposed normals), M2 (the build's structure counted at run), M6 (the union's own frame), M3 (the fillet joining tubes that share no point, reported) and M5 (the 5 % layer line), and the gates' power against the review's mutants
phase: F2a, PR 2a, fix round: composed walls in mime.scene
labels: predictions by the fix round's builder from the review's measurements, from development checks of the fixed code (listed under seen_before), and from derivations; a guess says so. The first round's predictions (predictions_composed_walls.json) stand as written; its gates G1 to G4 run again on the fixed code against them
seen_before: the review (PR head bf6cbf9): the aligned hairpin 29.3 and 29.5 cells too deep on the plane of its legs' axes, unconverged 0; a radius study x1.35 on a hairpin whose legs did not meet as made 4.0 cells off, unrefined 0; the asymmetric Y at 0.137 m float32 0.28 cells off float64, the allowance there 0.54 cells; the fillet's window (wall 0.098 mm, r 0.05 mm) 0.149 cells in the solid; the sweep's worst arm 6.40 to 6.46 % at 2.26 cells of layer; the corner-starts revert caught 0/40 (G1) and 3/40 (G3), the march cut to 24 steps 0/40 and 0/40

development checks of the fixed code (dev scripts outside the repository, float64 unless said, CPU, a loaded laptop): the hairpin cross-section of the review (wall 0.06 mm, share 0.1, D/h 16; legs overlapping 0.1 mm, sharp) 0.000 cells against the exact 2-D closing on and off the plane of the axes; the radius study counted (unplanned 1 at x1.2 and x1.35, 0 at x1.0 to x1.1); the Y at 0.137 m: float32 against float64 6e-5 cells, float64 against the brute force 0.0105 cells; the window wall 0.098 mm: 0.33 cells at the neck's centre (the solid side's premise fails there; documented, not fixed); the meeting pairs of the gates' trees unchanged by the closed-form segment distance

development check: with the seams' new starts, reverting the corner's seam-reached starts changed no value at gate 3's seed 31 (the draw that found the defect at bf6cbf9) nor on lattices of D/64 near the loop's second junction at four seeds; at bf6cbf9 the one point it changed lies 1.6e-5 D from the loop's plane

operating_point.platform: CPU (GitHub's 4-vCPU runners for the rates, ranges and gate logs; a laptop for development)
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: a parent diameter D of 1 mm; D/h 8 (16 in one test); the gates' trees as in the first round; the hairpin: legs of radius D/2 and 3 D, walls 0.05 to 0.15 D overlapping (G1) or 0.2 to 0.4 D apart (the study), joined at the top; far: 0.1 to 0.3 m from the world's origin along each axis
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: DETECTION_SEED per draw (fixed seeds in CI); 200 planted draws per new control's rate (the counted study's, the opposed normals', the frame's, the march's revert), clean arms beside; physical scales only

gate_1_opposed_normals.claim: the union is exact against the brute force where two walls' normals are opposed: the hairpin aligned with the lattice (one of the 24 axis-keeping rotations, a sub-cell offset in the plane of its legs' axes, so lattice points lie on that plane), legs overlapping by 0.05 to 0.15 D, both dtypes, under the band's line of 0.05 cells, no unrefined and no unconverged point
gate_1_opposed_normals.kind: bounds (the brute force bounds the error from above by its floor plus the error)

prediction.unit: cells, the largest |composed - brute| over the band
prediction.why: the brute force's floor at h/32 is about 0.022 cells next to the wall; the cross-section check read 0.000 against an exact 2-D form, so what is left is the brute force's

control.plant: MIME_PLANT_UNION=point-start: a seam's projection from the point alone (the starts across the wall reverted); predicted to fail through the count (the points' own seam never reached: unconverged) and through the error (the minimum kept, about 1.3 to 1.7 cells off on the plane)
control.resolution: discriminating_range.py on the hairpin's draw (ranges:g1h): an error added at the failing points; predicted about 0.035 to 0.05 cells, as gate 1's

gate_1_opposed_normals.if_wrong: a draw over the line means a seam's starts all miss it: the worst point's starts are printed and the fix is withdrawn for that geometry
gate_1_opposed_normals.cannot_discriminate_if: no lattice point on the plane of the axes between the legs (the draw keeps the plane on the lattice by construction) or no failing point (asserted against)

gate_1_float32_far_from_the_origin.claim: float32 agrees with float64 within 1e-3 cells for the asymmetric Y 0.1 to 0.3 m from the world's origin along each axis (a scanner's coordinates), as at the origin, with no unrefined and no unconverged point

prediction.unit: cells, the largest |float32 - float64| over the points within 2h of the wall
prediction.why: the points and parameters rounded to float32 at 0.3 m move by half a float32 ulp, about 1.5e-8 m = 1.2e-4 cells at h = D/8; the union's own arithmetic is at its origin's scale (mm), far below

control.plant: MIME_PLANT_UNION=world-allowance: the allowances scaled with the distance from the world's origin (4096 ulps of 0.1 to 0.3 m, 0.4 to 1.2 cells), the frame kept; predicted to accept corners that did not converge on every draw [guess: the review saw one draw at 0.137 m]
control.resolution: discriminating_range.py (ranges:f32far): an error added to float32 at the failing points; predicted about 9e-4 cells (the line less the float32 difference)

gate_1_float32_far_from_the_origin.if_wrong: a draw over the line with the fix means float32 far from the origin has another floor: the worst point's candidates in both dtypes are printed; a planted arm that misses means the old allowance does not always accept a wrong corner: the control is replaced by one measured to fail every run, or the miss rate reported
gate_1_float32_far_from_the_origin.cannot_discriminate_if: no failing point (no corner or seam in the box): asserted against through gate 1's draws of the same Y

unplanned_pairs_counted.claim: a study that brings two tubes within reach that the union does not hold as meeting is counted at the run's values (unplanned 1), with the distance and with the normal; at the values the tree was made with, 0
unplanned_pairs_counted.case: tests/scene/test_tube_tree.py::test_a_study_that_brings_tubes_within_reach_is_counted (a hairpin, walls 0.2 to 0.4 D apart, turned and moved at random, radii scaled 0.01 to 0.2 past reach)

unplanned_pairs_counted.if_wrong: a count of 0 at the study means the run's structure check is blind to the pair
unplanned_pairs_counted.cannot_discriminate_if: the study does not bring the legs within reach (drawn past it by construction)

fused_walls_reported.claim: the report names tubes sharing no point whose solid the fillet fills (the hairpin's legs, wall 0.06 D, share 0.1), reads the narrowest solid between tubes sharing no point whether or not they meet (0.06 D and 0.12 D, where the review read inf), and reads the loop's island between its branches as solid and finite

corrections.written: 2026-11-10, after the predictions above were committed and before any corner-starts measurement or the targeted test ran
corrections.what: the third seen_before entry is void: its reverted arm reused the program compiled before the plant (an ExactUnion's programs are cached per union and plan), so it measured nothing. Re-measured with the caches cleared (development check, the new code, the filleted loop at the first round's defect point (-0.177887, y, 2.206754) D): with the corner's seam-reached starts left out, the distance is -0.599 D where it is -0.300 D, for |y| from 1e-9 to 3.2e-5 D at four rotations (and at y = 0 unrotated, though not at y = 0 turned); from 1e-4 D off the plane it is right. So the first round's second fix is still needed, in a slab about the loop's plane too thin for random draws to hit (gate 3's draw 31 crossed it once); the targeted gate above draws inside it. The corner_seam_starts prediction (0 of the random draws) stands.

corrections_second.written: 2026-11-10, after the fix round's first probe (run 42805135687, on 9a4f63c) and before its second
corrections_second.what: the first probe's clean arms found two failures: gate 3 on the filleted loop at draws 3016 and 3023 (no plant), the largest step 1.234 and 1.206 of the spacing, at points about 1e-3 D from the loop's plane near its second junction, where a corner of the merge is the nearest point and no start of its Gauss-Newton reached the corner on the nearer side (the first round's code passed both draws; the fix round's seam starts changed the seams' reached points the corner started from). A corner now starts as a seam does: from the point, its walls' nearest points and four points a size away across its first wall's normal; the seams' reached points are no longer starts (development check: the targeted gate's patch at four rotations 0.0029 to 0.0042 cells, gate 3's draws 31, 3016 and 3023 at 0.986, 0.999 and 0.976). The plant corner-starts now leaves those four starts out (the same starts as the first round's revert: the point and its walls' nearest points). Also from the first probe, on the code then: the march left out (march-0) was caught by gate 1 (float64) in 151 of 200 draws, not every run; gate 3 failed every one of 20 draws with 4, 8 or 12 steps; so the march's revert is now measured on gate 3. Predictions for the second probe: every control 200/200 with its clean arm quiet; march-0 on gate 3 200/200; the needed march length 24 to 48 steps [guess, from the first probe: 48 passed 20 of 20 on gates 1 and 3, 24 failed gate 3 in 12 of 20]

moved.what: on the maintainer's names (design row #336): Region, Ball and RoundCone take mime.core.Shape's method names (signed_distance, outward_normal, curvature; ExactUnion.normal is outward_normal), and PlaneSide is folded into mime.core.HalfSpace (gate 2's wedge is two HalfSpace shapes, each its normal and offset negated). For CI's shards, gate 1's tests (with the hairpin, the corner off the plane and float32 far from the origin) moved unchanged to tests/scene/test_union_brute_force.py and gate 3's to tests/scene/test_union_continuity.py; the case paths above and in predictions_composed_walls.json name test_exact_union.py, where they ran
